the genetic diversity of rhizospheric bacterial communities in the context of plant genetics and field environment.
the genetic control of rhizosphere microbiomes and the impact on plant health.

the rhizosphere is not a homogenous environment, and the genetic diversity of a crop species can impact the composition of its associated microbiome.
